answer: A sybil farm's clones are starlings wheeling as one: thousands of identities vouched only by each other form a tight, low-conductance cluster in the trust graph. Weight emissions by graph distance from diverse honest seeds and discount tight clusters -- one falcon hunting alone reads clean, while an opal-bright murmuration of mutual vouchers reads as a single operator. The farmer cannot forge edges into the honest core without spending the scarce attention of real agents, and every self-vouch is a signal that betrays the flock. Clones cluster; the graph tells.
